name: camofox-browser-mcp

tools.name: camofox_health
tools.description: Checks whether the local camofox-browser server is reachable and reports browser runtime status.

inputSchema.description: No input. Returns health and runtime status from camofox-browser.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_health.

inputSchema.description: No input. Returns health and runtime status from camofox-browser.

tools.name: camofox_start_browser
tools.description: Starts the camofox browser engine and returns startup status for the local server.

inputSchema.description: No input. Starts the camofox browser engine if needed.

tools.name: camofox_list_tabs
tools.description: Lists currently open tabs for a user in camofox-browser, including tab identifiers and URLs.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: List open tabs for a user session.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_list_tabs.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: List open tabs for a user session.

tools.name: camofox_create_tab
tools.description: Creates a new tab in camofox-browser, optionally navigated to a provided URL.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key for grouping tabs. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_SESSION_KEY.

url.description: Optional initial URL to open in the newly created tab.

inputSchema.description: Create a new browser tab in camofox-browser.

tools.name: create_tab
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_create_tab.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key for grouping tabs. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_SESSION_KEY.

url.description: Optional initial URL to open in the newly created tab.

inputSchema.description: Create a new browser tab in camofox-browser.

tools.name: camofox_navigate_tab
tools.description: Navigates an existing tab to a URL or a supported macro destination in camofox-browser.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key used if the tab is auto-created by /navigate.

macro.description: Optional search macro such as @twitter_search or @google_search.

query.description: Query text used by macro-based navigation.

inputSchema.description: Navigate a tab to a URL or macro target.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_navigate_tab.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key used if the tab is auto-created by /navigate.

macro.description: Optional search macro such as @twitter_search or @google_search.

query.description: Query text used by macro-based navigation.

inputSchema.description: Navigate a tab to a URL or macro target.

tools.name: navigate_and_snapshot
tools.description: Navigates to a URL or macro target, waits for readiness, then captures a snapshot.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate before snapshot capture.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key used if navigate auto-creates tab context.

waitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds after navigation.

waitForNetwork.description: If true, includes network-idle wait before snapshot.

includeScreenshot.description: If true, includes base64 screenshot payload in snapshot response.

offset.description: Optional snapshot offset for large pages.

inputSchema.description: Navigate to a target and immediately return a fresh snapshot.

tools.name: camofox_get_snapshot
tools.description: Retrieves an accessibility snapshot for a tab, including interactive element refs for reliable automation.

tabId.description: Tab id for the snapshot request.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

includeScreenshot.description: If true, includes a base64 screenshot in the response.

offset.description: Snapshot pagination offset for long pages.

inputSchema.description: Get an accessibility snapshot with stable element refs.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_get_snapshot.

tabId.description: Tab id for the snapshot request.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

includeScreenshot.description: If true, includes a base64 screenshot in the response.

offset.description: Snapshot pagination offset for long pages.

inputSchema.description: Get an accessibility snapshot with stable element refs.

tools.name: camofox_wait
tools.description: Waits for the target tab page to settle, useful after navigations and async content updates.

tabId.description: Tab id to wait on.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

waitForNetwork.description: If true, also waits for network idle when possible.

inputSchema.description: Wait until page is ready after navigation or dynamic updates.

tools.name: camofox_wait_for_text
tools.description: Waits for specific text to appear in a tab using backend /act wait.

tabId.description: Tab id to monitor for text appearance.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

text.description: Text to wait for on the page.

inputSchema.description: Wait until specific text appears in the page.

tools.name: camofox_click
tools.description: Clicks a page element in the target tab using either a snapshot ref or CSS selector.

tabId.description: Tab id where the click should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref such as e1. Preferred over CSS selectors.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector if no ref is available.

inputSchema.description: Click an element in a tab by ref or selector.

tools.name: batch_click
tools.description: Executes multiple click actions in sequence and returns per-action outcomes.

tabId.description: Tab id where batched clicks are executed.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Element ref target for this click.

selector.description: CSS selector target for this click.

actions.description: Ordered list of click actions to execute.

delayMs.description: Delay between click actions in milliseconds.

inputSchema.description: Execute multiple click actions sequentially with per-item results.

tools.name: camofox_type
tools.description: Types text into an element identified by ref or selector, with optional Enter key submission.

tabId.description: Tab id where typing should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref where text should be typed.

pressEnter.description: If true, presses Enter after typing completes.

inputSchema.description: Type text into an input element, optionally followed by Enter.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_type.

tabId.description: Tab id where typing should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref where text should be typed.

pressEnter.description: If true, presses Enter after typing completes.

inputSchema.description: Type text into an input element, optionally followed by Enter.

tools.name: type_and_submit
tools.description: Types text into an input and sends a submit keypress (default Enter) in one call.

tabId.description: Tab id where typing should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

text.description: Text to type before submit keypress.

inputSchema.description: Type into an input and submit with a keypress in one call.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fills multiple form fields in sequence and optionally clicks a submit target.

tabId.description: Tab id where form filling occurs.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Snapshot ref for the input field.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the input field.

value.description: Value to fill into the field.

fields.description: List of fields to fill in order.

inputSchema.description: Fill multiple form inputs, with optional submit click.

tools.name: camofox_hover
tools.description: Hovers over a page element using either a snapshot ref or CSS selector.

tabId.description: Tab id where hover should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref such as e1. Preferred over CSS selector.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector when ref is unavailable.

inputSchema.description: Hover over an element to trigger tooltips, menus, or hover states.

tools.name: camofox_press
tools.description: Presses a keyboard key in the target tab (for example Enter, Escape, ArrowDown).

tabId.description: Tab id where keypress should happen.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

key.description: Keyboard key to press (for example Enter, Escape, ArrowDown).

inputSchema.description: Press a keyboard key in the active tab context.

tools.name: camofox_scroll
tools.description: Scrolls a tab vertically by a configurable amount, useful for loading additional content.

tabId.description: Tab id to scroll.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Scroll the active page within a tab.

tools.name: camofox_scroll_element
tools.description: Scrolls a referenced element into view within the active tab.

tabId.description: Tab id containing the target scrollable element.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

ref.description: Element ref to scroll into view, typically from camofox_get_snapshot.

inputSchema.description: Scroll an element into view using its snapshot ref.

tools.name: scroll_and_snapshot
tools.description: Scrolls the page and returns a fresh snapshot in one call.

tabId.description: Tab id to scroll before snapshot capture.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

includeScreenshot.description: If true, includes screenshot payload in snapshot response.

offset.description: Optional snapshot offset for large pages.

inputSchema.description: Scroll a page and immediately return an updated snapshot.

tools.name: camofox_back
tools.description: Navigates one step back in the tab history.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_back.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: camofox_forward
tools.description: Navigates one step forward in the tab history.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_forward.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: camofox_refresh
tools.description: Reloads the current page in the target tab.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_refresh.

tabId.description: Tab id to navigate in history.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Navigate browser history within a tab.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Runs a web search macro (Google/YouTube/etc.) by navigating an existing or new tab.

engine.description: Search engine selector mapped to a camofox macro.

tabId.description: Optional existing tab id. If omitted, a new tab is created.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Optional session key used when creating a tab.

inputSchema.description: Navigate a tab to a search result page using camofox macros.

tools.name: camofox_get_links
tools.description: Extracts and paginates HTTP links from the current tab page.

tabId.description: Tab id where links should be extracted.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return in this page.

offset.description: Offset into the extracted links list.

inputSchema.description: Extract links from the current page with pagination support.

tools.name: camofox_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a PNG screenshot for the target tab.

tabId.description: Tab id for screenshot capture.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

fullPage.description: If true, captures the full scrollable page.

inputSchema.description: Capture a PNG screenshot from the target tab.

tools.name: camofox_get_stats
tools.description: Returns per-tab stats including visited URLs, tool call count, and ref count.

tabId.description: Tab id to inspect.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Fetch tab statistics and usage metadata.

tools.name: camofox_close_tab
tools.description: Closes an open tab and frees related resources in the selected user session.

tabId.description: Tab id to close.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Close a tab in camofox-browser.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Compatibility alias for camofox_close_tab.

tabId.description: Tab id to close.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Close a tab in camofox-browser.

tools.name: camofox_close_tab_group
tools.description: Closes every tab in a specific session key/tab group.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

sessionKey.description: Preferred tab group identifier to close.

listItemId.description: Legacy tab group identifier alias for sessionKey.

inputSchema.description: Close all tabs in a tab group/session key.

tools.name: camofox_close_session
tools.description: Closes all tabs and browser context state for a user session.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

inputSchema.description: Close an entire user browser session and all related tabs.

tools.name: camofox_stop_browser
tools.description: Stops the camofox browser engine and clears all active sessions.

adminKey.description: Optional admin key override. Defaults to CAMOFOX_ADMIN_KEY.

inputSchema.description: Stop the browser engine and clear all sessions.

tools.name: camofox_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Extracts available YouTube captions/transcript text for a provided video URL.

url.description: YouTube video URL to extract captions from.

languages.description: Optional preferred language codes in priority order, e.g. ["en"].

inputSchema.description: Extract transcript text from a YouTube video via camofox-browser backend.

tools.name: camofox_import_cookies
tools.description: Imports cookies into a camofox-browser session from direct input or a local JSON cookie file.

userId.description: Optional user id. Defaults to CAMOFOX_DEFAULT_USER_ID.

expires.description: Cookie expiry as unix timestamp in seconds. Use -1 for session cookies.

cookiesFilePath.description: Path to a JSON cookie export file. Supports array format and {cookies:[...]} format.

inputSchema.description: Import cookies into camofox-browser for authenticated sessions.
